integrity: A complete infinite-length proof and three bounded computational cross-checks are included; search-based originality has residual bibliographic uncertainty; no independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite binary linear strings with noiseless complete compositions of substrings of lengths one to three only; it does not claim uniqueness up to reversal, any encoding complexity bound, noisy reconstruction, other alphabets, or larger observed substring lengths.
title: Exact rational census of binary three-length-limited composition profiles
